entities.summary: Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University, Hyderabad is a collegiate public state university located in Kukatpally, Hyderabad, Telangana, India. Founded in 1965 as the Nagarjuna Sagar Engineering College, it was established as a university in 1972 by "The Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University Act, 1972'".
